src_file <- "
31-generalized-hierarchical-and-bayesian-mixture-models.md
"
# Locate the monograph file via the installed package directory.
pkg_dir <- dirname(system.file("DESCRIPTION", package = "mixRSMflow"))
if (nzchar(pkg_dir)) {
  src <- file.path(pkg_dir, "monographs", src_file)
} else {
  src <- ""
}
if (nzchar(src) && file.exists(src)) {
  cat(readLines(src, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat("**Extended tutorial not found.**\n")
}
